summary: Russia launched a massive combined drone and missile barrage across Ukraine, delivering approximately 500 UAVs including Geran-2, Geran-4/5, and Shaheds targeting western, central, and northern regions while ballistic missiles threatened Kyiv. Ukrainian forces struck the Roboavia drone factory in Russia and conducted a large-scale drone attack on Saint Petersburg hitting an oil terminal, cargo bridge, VK data center, and causing widespread power outages. Russian forces fired six ballistic missiles at Zaporizhstal in the fifth major attack since August and executed Ukrainian prisoners of war in Zaporizhzhia region according to intercepted communications.
key_points: Russia delivered ~500 strike and reactive UAVs to all launch positions, signaling intensified attacks on western Ukraine in coming week. (Source: @eRadarrua/124170)
Ukrainian drones attacked Saint Petersburg overnight, striking cargo bridge, oil terminal, VK data center, and substation, causing blackouts and airport restrictions. (Source: @UkraineNow/84732)
Ukrainian forces struck Roboavia drone factory in Russia, aiming to reduce Russian drone production for frontline use. (Source: @UkraineNow/84726)
Russian ballistic missiles targeted Kyiv, with air raid alerts and Geran-5 rockets hitting Desnyanskyi district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77147, @mon1tor_ua/77180)
Six Russian ballistic missiles hit Zaporizhstal steel plant, the fifth major attack since August, totaling 23 missiles. (Source: @UkraineNow/84721)
Russian forces executed Ukrainian POWs in Zaporizhzhia region, captured on intercepted radio with explicit kill orders. (Source: @UkraineNow/84724)

Massive Shahed and Geran-5 waves targeted multiple regions: Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Khmelnytskyi, Rivne, Lviv, Vinnytsia, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Mykolaiv, Kherson. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77149, @mon1tor_ua/77172, @mon1tor_ua/77173)
Russian Pantsir-S1 air defense fired on residential buildings in Saint Petersburg during drone attack. (Source: @eRadarrua/124147)

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a massive coordinated drone and missile offensive across Ukraine with approximately 500 UAVs deployed, including Geran-2, Geran-4/5, and Shahed systems, while ballistic missiles targeted Kyiv and Zaporizhstal. Ukraine responded with strategic strikes on the Roboavia drone factory in Russia and a large-scale drone attack on Saint Petersburg critical infrastructure. Russian forces simultaneously executed Ukrainian prisoners of war in Zaporizhzhia and fired air defense systems at civilian areas in Saint Petersburg.

points: Ukrainian forces struck the Roboavia drone manufacturing plant in Russia, with the General Staff stating the attack will reduce the number of drones Russia sends to the frontline. (Source: @UkraineNow/84726)

Ukrainian drones conducted a massive overnight attack on Saint Petersburg and Leningrad region, hitting a cargo bridge on the Western High-Speed Diameter, an oil terminal in the port, the VK data center, and a substation, causing power outages and Pulkovo airport restrictions. (Source: @UkraineNow/84732, @eRadarrua/124135, @eRadarrua/124140)
A MiG-29 pilot from the Ukrainian Air Force reported the brigade destroyed over 130 targets in a month, including reactive UAVs, with round-the-clock interception sorties. (Source: @kpszsu/87958)

The 'Air Alert' application added a real-time map showing enemy drone and missile movements, types, and approximate directions, sourced directly from Air Force and Ministry of Defense secure channels. (Source: @UkraineNow/84728)

President Zelensky warned that Lviv, Ternopil, Lutsk and other western cities may face ballistic missile threats as Russia plans to deploy launchers in Belarus, and emphasized Putin seeks Ukraine's destruction, not just capitulation. (Source: @UkraineNow/84720)

Ukrainian air defense units actively engaged incoming threats across multiple regions, with reactive UAVs reported over Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Lviv, Vinnytsia, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, and other oblasts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77149, @mon1tor_ua/77172, @mon1tor_ua/77173, @kpszsu/87936, @kpszsu/87937)

Russian forces delivered approximately 500 strike UAVs (Geran-2) and reactive UAVs (Geran-4/5) to all possible launch locations, with expectations of intensified attacks on western Ukrainian regions over the next week. (Source: @eRadarrua/124170)

Russia launched six ballistic missiles at the Zaporizhstal steel plant in Zaporizhzhia, marking the fifth major attack on the facility since August, with a total of 23 missiles fired at the complex. (Source: @UkraineNow/84721)

Russian ballistic missiles, possibly Iskander-M, S-300, or Zircon, were threatened from Kursk region, while Geran-5 rockets struck Kyiv's Desnyanskyi district and multiple other cities. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77150, @mon1tor_ua/77180, @mon1tor_ua/77176)

Intercepted Russian military communications revealed explicit orders to execute Ukrainian prisoners of war in Zaporizhzhia region, with phrases like 'finish off that 300th one' and 'zero them immediately'. (Source: @UkraineNow/84724)
A Russian Pantsir-S1 air defense system fired on residential buildings in Saint Petersburg during the Ukrainian drone attack, causing collateral damage. (Source: @eRadarrua/124147)

Russian attacks targeted critical infrastructure including the Kromberg & Schubert automotive cable plant in Lutsk, which halted production, and energy facilities across Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/84725, @UkraineNow/84720)
Zaporizhstal steel plant in Zaporizhzhia region endured its fifth massive ballistic missile attack since August, with six missiles launched in the latest strike. (Source: @UkraineNow/84721)
Russian forces executed Ukrainian prisoners of war in Zaporizhzhia region, with intercepted radio communications capturing direct kill orders. (Source: @UkraineNow/84724)
A 'Banderoil' UAV was observed near Sharivka in Kharkiv region moving southwest, indicating continued reconnaissance or strike activity in the sector. (Source: @kpszsu/87926)
Dnipropetrovsk region experienced a Russian strike on a critical infrastructure object, with the OVA head reporting no casualties. (Source: @eRadarrua/124173)
Multiple 'Banderoil' UAVs were tracked over Dnipropetrovsk region heading toward Dnipro from the southwest. (Source: @kpszsu/87943)
Reactive UAVs were reported near Komyshuvakha in Zaporizhzhia region moving north. (Source: @kpszsu/87947)

Chernihiv region faced multiple waves of strike UAVs and reactive UAVs, with groups targeting Slavutych, Kozelets, Koriukivka, and Mena areas. (Source: @eRadarrua/124100, @eRadarrua/124122, @eRadarrua/124134, @eRadarrua/124138, @kpszsu/87946, @kpszsu/87944)
Sumy region reported a 'Banderoil' UAV and strike UAV group activity, with threats of ballistic missile launches from nearby Kursk region. (Source: @eRadarrua/124138, @mon1tor_ua/77150)

Kyiv and Kyiv region experienced ballistic missile threats, air raid alerts, and Geran-5 rocket impacts in Desnyanskyi district, with reactive UAVs tracked near Stavyshche, Krasiatychi, and Vyshhorod district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77147, @mon1tor_ua/77149, @mon1tor_ua/77180, @mon1tor_ua/77182, @kpszsu/87936, @kpszsu/87949, @eRadarrua/124121, @eRadarrua/124145)

Zhytomyr region saw intensive reactive UAV activity near Korosten, Luhyny, Horodnytsia, Andrushivka, Malyn, Ozerne, and Korostyshiv, with some heading toward Rivne region. (Source: @kpszsu/87927, @kpszsu/87929, @kpszsu/87932, @kpszsu/87951, @kpszsu/87952, @kpszsu/87953, @kpszsu/87954, @mon1tor_ua/77176, @mon1tor_ua/77175, @eRadarrua/124176, @eRadarrua/124168)
Cherkasy region was targeted by three Geran-5 rockets from Kirovohrad region and reactive UAVs near Vilshana. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77173, @kpszsu/87933, @eRadarrua/124155)
